description: Find suppliers and reference data; this never searches inventory. catalogue (default) lists reviewed suppliers, ten compact rows per page, filtered by category, query or connected. award_programs lists loyalty-program coverage and bank transfer relationships. booking_guide gives official booking steps for an Aeroplan, Flying Blue or Virgin Atlantic award the traveler has chosen. registry searches the public MCP registry for unreviewed candidates, which cannot be executed. Query with provider or capability names, never private trip details.

operating_carriers.description: Actual operating-airline IATA codes for all selected segments, not marketing codes. Omit if unknown.

party.description: Adults and accompanied children use the program’s age definitions; infants are under two at travel. Zero adults with children requires unaccompanied-minor verification. Omit if unknown.

program.description: Exact redemption program. Virgin Red, bank currencies and operating airlines are not aliases.

connected.description: Catalogue mode. true lists only installed suppliers that search_travel can call; false lists only reviewed candidates.

detail.description: Catalogue mode. compact (default) names each source and its tools; full adds hosts, evidence links and per-method freshness.

limit.description: Rows per page for catalogue and award_programs (default 10).

offset.description: Row offset for catalogue or award_programs.

query.description: One provider ID, name, capability term or country per call, matched as a literal substring; a country also matches the words sources use for it (Norway finds Norwegian). Exact ID and name matches come first. Not a sentence or a list. Omit to browse. Registry mode searches its remote index.

name: find_sources
title: Find travel sources
